core: Arachidonic acid eicosanoid synthesis and signaling
qualifier: cyclooxygenase prostanoid and cytochrome P450 hydroxylase/epoxygenase branches
name: Cyclooxygenase and P450 eicosanoid synthesis and signaling
rationale: All members concern eicosanoid production or response via COX-derived prostaglandins/thromboxanes and P450-derived HETEs/EETs, unlike confusables centred on lipoxygenase leukotrienes, lipoxins and resolvins.

qualifier: CFTR-dependent
name: CFTR-dependent epithelial chloride and water transport
rationale: Members cover CFTR trafficking and its cystic fibrosis defect plus transepithelial water and ion transport, whereas confusables are SLC26/SLC4/SLC12 anion exchangers and cotransporters.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
qualifier: cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: MHC class I and II antigen presentation and HIV evasion
rationale: Members span peptide loading on MHC I and II, cross-presentation and proteasomal antigen processing plus HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC I, CD4 and CD8, unlike confusables limited to proteasome assembly or DC/CD1 lipid presentation.

core: Endosomal TLR and TRIF signaling to IKK, TAK1 and IRFs
qualifier: including inherited herpes simplex encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR and TRIF signaling, incl. herpes encephalitis deficiencies
rationale: Members describe TLR3/TRIF and TLR7/8/9 signaling via IRAK, TRAF6, RIP1 to TAK1, IKK and IRF3/7 with UNC93B1/TLR3/TICAM1/TRAF3 HSE defects, unlike confusables centred on generic NF-kB, necroptosis or cytosolic antiviral sensing.

qualifier: E1-E2 transfer and transcription factor targets
name: SUMO E1-E2 conjugation and transcription factor SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO loading onto E1 and transfer to UBC9 plus SUMOylation of transcription factors, whereas confusables cover SUMOylation of other substrate classes and SUMO processing or removal.

qualifier: RNA export and NPC assembly/disassembly
name: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and RNA nuclear export
rationale: Members concern the NPC, its assembly and disassembly, and transport of mRNA, tRNA, ribosomal subunits, inositol phosphates and HIV Rev through it, unlike confusables on nuclear envelope reformation or regulated protein import.

qualifier: plus trimethylammonium compounds: choline, carnitine, trimethylamine
name: Sulfur, selenium and trimethylammonium compound metabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, sulfide and selenium compound metabolism together with choline, carnitine and FMO3-mediated trimethylamine oxidation, which the amino-acid, glutathione and cofactor confusables lack.

qualifier: UGT1A glucuronidation and ABCC2 biliary export
name: Heme degradation and bilirubin conjugation and excretion
rationale: All members concern heme breakdown and bilirubin glucuronidation or canalicular export and their hyperbilirubinemia defects, unlike confusables on SLCO uptake and drug ADME.

qualifier: sialic acid and N-acetylglucosamine
name: Sialic acid and N-acetylglucosamine metabolism
rationale: Members concern sialic acid synthesis/catabolism (GNE, CMP-Neu5Ac) and GlcNAc/fructose-6-phosphate interconversion, unlike confusables on N-glycan, lysosomal ganglioside or UDP-GlcNAc synthesis.

qualifier: promoting macrophage cholesterol storage and foam cells
name: Lipoprotein cholesterol uptake and macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members concern lipoprotein signaling and cholesterol import promoting storage and foam cell differentiation, whereas confusables emphasize HDL assembly, cholesterol efflux and LXR-driven suppression of foam cells.

qualifier: centromeric CENP-A nucleosome deposition
name: Centromeric CENP-A chromatin assembly and protein acetylation
rationale: Members cover nucleosome and CENP-A chromatin assembly together with histone/lysine acetylation, unlike confusables on BAF/CHD remodeling or chromosome condensation.

qualifier: ABC-transporter sterol/bile export and HDL/LDL remodeling
name: Intestinal lipid absorption, biliary ABC-transporter export and HDL remodeling
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid absorption, ABCG5/G8, ABCB4 and ABCB11 sterol, phospholipid and bile acid export and HDL/LDL remodeling, which the VLDL, chylomicron-clearance and cholesterol-storage confusables lack.

qualifier: negative regulation
name: TGF-beta-SMAD signaling and its negative regulation
rationale: All members concern TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling and its inhibition, unlike confusables on BMP-driven mesenchymal fate, fibrosis or miRNA processing.

qualifier: atrophy, hypertrophic growth and fiber-type switching
name: Striated muscle adaptation: atrophy, growth and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members concern muscle responses to activity and inactivity, cell size control, atrophy, regeneration and fiber-type transition, unlike confusables on calcineurin-NFAT hypertrophy signaling or myogenesis and contraction.

qualifier: definitive endoderm specification exiting pluripotency
name: Gastrulation and definitive endoderm specification from pluripotency
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, gastrulation EMT and mesendoderm with endoderm and gut-tube specification and OCT4/SOX2/NANOG control, whereas confusables emphasize lateral plate and cardiac mesoderm.

qualifier: pre-mRNA splicing, snRNA and 3'-end processing, nuclear surveillance and export
name: Pre-mRNA and snRNA processing, nuclear surveillance and export
rationale: Members cover spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis, mRNA and histone 3'-end processing, nuclear exosome decay and mRNA export, unlike confusables on Pol I/III rRNA synthesis or cytoplasmic 5'-to-3' mRNA decay.

qualifier: classical and alternative pathways
name: Classical and alternative complement activation and regulation
rationale: All members concern complement activation through classical and alternative pathways, C3/C5 activation and its regulation, unlike confusables on the lectin pathway or phagocyte effector functions.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7, IL-15 and IL-21 with NK cell expansion
name: IL-2, IL-7, IL-15 and IL-21 gamma-chain cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/STAT5, IL-7, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling and NK cell differentiation and proliferation, distinct from confusables with IL-10/12/23, IL-9 or NKT regulation.

qualifier: NK and CD8 T cell killing and its regulation
name: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity and its regulation
rationale: Members concern NK receptor/KIR signatures, granzyme killing, regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity and tolerance, unlike confusables on CD4 T cell costimulation and dendritic cell activation.

qualifier: R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink resolution
name: Replication stress, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink resolution
rationale: Members cover replication initiation and stress responses (hydroxyurea, camptothecin), R-loop processing, DNA-protein crosslink repair and coupled transcription termination, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair, telomeres or DNA topology.

qualifier: p53-regulated, with necroptosis and oncogene/oxidative-stress senescence
name: p53-regulated apoptosis, necroptosis and stress-induced senescence
rationale: Members span intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis machinery, necroptosis, p53 regulation and oncogene- or stress-induced senescence, whereas confusables cover only the death pathways or only p53/senescence.

qualifier: white, brown and beige fat with thermogenesis
name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members concern adipogenesis, PPARG regulation, white/brown/beige fat differentiation and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis, unlike confusables on hepatic lipogenesis, lipid droplet turnover or PGC-1alpha mitochondrial programs.

qualifier: effector control of actin protrusions and cell motility
name: Rho GTPase control of actin protrusions and cell motility
rationale: Members are Rho/Rac/CDC42 GTPase cycles and effectors regulating actin polymerization, lamellipodia, filopodia and motility, unlike confusables on G12/13 Rho activation, axon guidance or cell junctions.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and recruitment
rationale: Members concern positive and negative regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis, recruitment and apoptosis via formyl peptide receptors, unlike confusables on extravasation, degranulation or chemokine production.

qualifier: downstream second messengers, PKC and NF-kB
name: Downstream TCR second-messenger and NF-kB lymphocyte activation
rationale: Members cover downstream TCR second-messenger, ITK/PKC and NF-kB signaling driving T and B cell activation and IL-2 production, unlike confusables on CD28 costimulation, proximal BCR signaling or thymic development.
